<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Shivam Kumar Dutta</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,300;9..144,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#000;
  --ink:#f3f3f1;
  --muted:#8e8e97;
  --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
  --glass-hi:rgba(255,255,255,.075);
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  --serif:"Fraunces",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --sans:"DM Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 84px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 16px/1.65 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:hidden}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9db4ff;outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}

/* soft light behind the glass so the blur has something to work with */
.orbs{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.55;animation:drift 32s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.orb.a{width:46vmax;height:46vmax;background:#22336b;top:-16vmax;left:-12vmax}
.orb.b{width:38vmax;height:38vmax;background:#4a2f6e;bottom:-14vmax;right:-10vmax;animation-duration:38s}
.orb.c{width:28vmax;height:28vmax;background:#164d55;top:42%;left:46%;opacity:.35;animation-duration:44s}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translate3d(6vmax,4vmax,0) scale(1.08)}}

.glass{background:var(--glass);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(140%);backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(140%);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.07)}

nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:10;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 14px) 16px 0;pointer-events:none}
nav .pill{pointer-events:auto;display:flex;gap:2px;padding:5px;border-radius:999px}
nav a{padding:7px 15px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);transition:color .25s,background .25s}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink);background:var(--glass-hi)}

main{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px 72px}
.hero{min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:110px 0 60px}
h1{font:300 clamp(46px,9vw,92px)/1.02 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 26px}
h1 span{display:inline-block;opacity:0;filter:blur(10px);transform:translateY(10px);animation:rise 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards}
h1 span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.14s}
h1 span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.28s}
@keyframes rise{to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0);transform:none}}
.lead{max-width:520px;color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(16px,2.2vw,19px);margin:0 0 12px;opacity:0;animation:fade 1s .7s ease forwards}
.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;opacity:0;animation:fade 1s .9s ease forwards}
@keyframes fade{to{opacity:1}}
.btn{padding:11px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:500;font-size:15px;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}
.btn.main{background:var(--ink);color:#000;border:1px solid var(--ink)}
.btn.main:hover{background:#fff}
.btn.ghost{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--glass);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:var(--glass-hi);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}

.avatar{display:block;width:112px;height:112px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin-bottom:30px;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--glass),0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6);opacity:0;animation:fade 1.2s .1s ease forwards}
.place{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin:0 0 34px;opacity:0;animation:fade 1s .8s ease forwards}
.cert h3{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 6px}
.cert p{margin:0}
section{padding:52px 0}
h2{font:300 clamp(28px,4.5vw,40px)/1.15 var(--serif);letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 24px}
.panel{padding:30px}
.panel p{margin:0;max-width:62ch;color:#cfcfd4}
.panel p+p{margin-top:14px}

.rows{display:grid;gap:14px}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:8px 24px;padding:20px 26px;align-items:baseline}
.row b{font-weight:500}
.row span{color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:14px}
.card{padding:26px;transition:background .35s,border-color .35s}
.card:hover{background:var(--glass-hi);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.card h3{font:400 22px/1.25 var(--serif);margin:0 0 10px}
.card p{margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.card a{font-size:14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:2px;transition:border-color .25s}
.card a:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}

.contact{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.contact p{margin:0;color:#cfcfd4}
.mail{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;color:var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:2px;transition:border-color .25s}
.mail:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
footer{position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;padding:0 22px 40px}

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

@media(max-width:600px){
  .row{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:18px 22px}
  .panel{padding:24px}
  nav a{padding:7px 9px;font-size:12.5px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  h1 span,.lead,.place,.avatar,.actions,.reveal{opacity:1;filter:none;transform:none}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="orbs" aria-hidden="true"><div class="orb a"></div><div class="orb b"></div><div class="orb c"></div></div>

<nav aria-label="Primary"><div class="pill glass">
  <a href="#about">About</a><a href="#skills">Skills</a><a href="#work">Work</a><a href="#certifications">Certificates</a><a href="#contact">Contact</a>
</div></nav>

<main>
  <header class="hero">
    <img class="avatar" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Shivam Kumar Dutta" width="112" height="112">
    <h1><span>Shivam</span> <span>Kumar</span> <span>Dutta</span></h1>
    <p class="lead">B.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering at Haldia Institute of Technology. Aspiring software developer learning DSA in Java and C++, passionate about AI.</p>
    <p class="place">Haldia, West Bengal, India</p>
    <div class="actions">
      <a class="btn main" href="#work">See my work</a>
      <a class="btn ghost" href="#contact">Get in touch</a>
    </div>
  </header>

  <section id="about" class="reveal">
    <h2>About</h2>
    <div class="panel glass">
      <p>Driven Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at Haldia Institute of Technology with a strong foundation in core software engineering principles, algorithms and artificial intelligence. I'm honing my problem-solving with Java and C++, and I want to use data science, efficient algorithms and modern software practice to build applications that are actually useful.</p>
      <p>Outside class I practise problems on LeetCode and HackerRank, and I share science ideas on my YouTube channel, Newtonian Insight.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="skills" class="reveal">
    <h2>Skills</h2>
    <div class="rows">
      <div class="row glass"><b>Languages</b><span>Java, C++, C</span></div>
      <div class="row glass"><b>Core</b><span>Data structures and algorithms, object-oriented programming</span></div>
      <div class="row glass"><b>Domains</b><span>Artificial intelligence and machine learning, data science and analytics</span></div>
      <div class="row glass"><b>Tools and practice</b><span>Web design, application development basics, problem solving on LeetCode and HackerRank</span></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="work" class="reveal">
    <h2>Work</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <article class="card glass">
        <h3>Newtonian Insight</h3>
        <p>A YouTube channel about science and discovery, where I explain ideas I find fascinating.</p>
        <a href="https://youtube.com/@NewtonianInsight" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Watch on YouTube</a>
      </article>
      <article class="card glass">
        <h3>Algorithm practice</h3>
        <p>Java and C++ solutions to classic problems, such as Two Sum and two-pointer palindrome checks.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="certifications" class="reveal">
    <h2>Certifications</h2>
    <div class="grid">
      <div class="card cert glass"><h3>Elements of AI</h3><p>University of Helsinki and MinnaLearn</p></div>
      <div class="card cert glass"><h3>Data Science and Analytics</h3><p>HP LIFE</p></div>
      <div class="card cert glass"><h3>Java (Basic) Skills</h3><p>HackerRank</p></div>
      <div class="card cert glass"><h3>Generative AI</h3><p>Workshops and technical masterminds</p></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="contact" class="reveal">
    <h2>Contact</h2>
    <div class="panel glass contact">
      <p>Open to opportunities, collaborations and a good conversation about tech.<br><a class="mail" href="mailto:shivamiitb007@gmail.com">shivamiitb007@gmail.com</a></p>
      <div class="links">
        <a class="btn main" href="mailto:shivamiitb007@gmail.com">Email me</a>
        <a class="btn ghost" href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/shivam-kumar-dutta-495994317" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer>©️ <span id="y">2026</span> Shivam Kumar Dutta</footer>

<script>
document.getElementById('y').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
var els=document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
    es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}});
  },{threshold:.15});
  els.forEach(function(el){io.observe(el)});
}else{els.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in')})}
</script>
</body>
</html>
